description: Does held-out accuracy on Batch 1 locate the epoch at which target accuracy peaks? 5-fold stratified cross-validation, folds fixed by a constant so only the initialisation varies with seed. Batch 1 only; no target file is opened.

target_informed_reference.note: Peaks of the target curves at seed 1042, for comparison only. These were seen before this experiment was designed and are not available to any stopping rule.
